Class UserAccountSummary

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.UserAccountSummary
public class UserAccountSummary extends Object

Title: UserAccountSummary Class.

Description: Constructs a password free summary containing the user account information that an admin is allowed to view

  • Constructor Details

    • UserAccountSummary

      public UserAccountSummary(String userName, String firstName, String middleName, String lastName, String preferredFirstName, String emailAddress, boolean adminRole, boolean role1, boolean role2)

      Method: UserAccountSummary

      Description: Constructs a password free user account summary

      Parameters:
      userName - specifies the account username
      firstName - specifies the user's first name
      middleName - specifies the user's middle name
      lastName - specifies the user's last name
      preferredFirstName - specifies the user's preferred first name
      emailAddress - specifies the user's email address
      adminRole - specifies whether the account has the Admin role
      role1 - specifies whether the account has the existing Role1 assignment
      role2 - specifies whether the account has the existing Role2 assignment

    • getDisplayName

      public String getDisplayName()

      Method: getDisplayName()

      Description: Formats the user's name for display on an account card. The preferred format is "Last name, First name". Missing names are handled without displaying extra punctuation or null values.

      Returns:
      the formatted account card name

    • getDisplayRoles

      public String getDisplayRoles()

      Method: getDisplayRoles()

      Description: Converts the stored role values into readable role names. Role1 and Role2 retain their current names until their meanings are defined during TP2.

      Returns:
      the account's formatted role names
